## About the Studio
Golden Armor Studio is an indie collective of artists, programmers, composers, and storytellers building thoughtful games for mobile and beyond. We blend nostalgic charm with modern design, delivering tactile gameplay, immersive soundscapes, and polished visuals that invite players to explore, compete, and collaborate.

## Featured Worlds
- **Color IQ Pro** – Challenge your perception across shifting gradients, climb the competitive ladder, and share your best runs with friends.
- **BattleDawn Pro** – Track live milestones, upcoming releases, and community-driven feature votes as the empire expands.
- **Community Hub** – A shared space for developer updates, roadmap deep-dives, and player feedback that shapes every sprint.

## What Drives Us
- **Crafted Experiences:** Intuitive controls, rich audio, and elegant UI tuned for quick delight and lasting mastery.
- **Player-First Roadmaps:** We iterate with our community and release updates based on player insights.
- **Built for Apple Platforms:** Native performance on iPhone, iPad, and Apple Silicon ensures buttery-smooth play.

## Support the Journey
Our supporters fuel experimentation and let us keep building ambitious worlds. Donate through the studio portal—powered by secure Stripe payments—to unlock in-game perks, early builds, and behind-the-scenes workshops.

## Tech Stack & Tools
- Frontend: Vue 3, Vue Router, Vuex, and modern CSS.
- Infrastructure: Firebase Hosting, Cloud Functions, and GitHub Actions automation.
- Payments & Analytics: Stripe, Firebase Extensions, and bespoke dashboards for live insights.

## Join the Guild
We love collaborating with curious builders and storytellers. Whether you craft code, art, music, or community, reach out—there’s always room at the forge.
